name: ASM-007 valve manifold assembly benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a compact pipe/manifold valve with flanged ports, stem, hand wheel, gasket rings, and mounting feet.

tasks.prompt: Create a compact valve manifold assembly with a manifold body, inlet and outlet flange modules, valve stem, hand wheel, gasket rings, and mounting feet. Use robust primitives and keep repeated parts meaningful.
assumptions: Intermediate assembly benchmark intended to exercise hierarchy, named modules, and repeated functional components without BRIEF-001 full-vehicle complexity.
Robust simple boxes, cylinders, and compounds are preferred over fragile booleans or detailed decorative hardware.
Generated STEP, GLB, topology, and component artifacts are produced by the CAD pipeline and are not hand-edited source of truth.
